rows.what_the_ink_shows: The group letters at the bottom diagram have looped, flowing upper bars and long curved stems turning at the foot: calligraphic T, not the angular Gamma reading described for the first pass. The same form appears in both upper-row nodes, the middle node, and the lower node; the lower identification is written beneath that same node. See crops/148_scan020_L1431_top.jpg, crops/148_scan020_L1431_middle.jpg, and crops/148_scan020_L1431_bottom.jpg.
rows.note: The supplied original LaTeX already has five occurrences of \mathcal T, including the repeated lower-node name in the separated Sl(2,Z) identification. The requested current reading is therefore already present. No change to the diagram or its surrounding independent uncertainties is required.
